description: Killing cold - frost that feeds on itself and pays back Life Force for every critical strike.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 36 real CoA Rime talents (role DPS, frost). frost_spell_damage is LIVE - built via an f-string at abilities.py:1371 and resolved against the ability's real school - so the seven CoA talents worded 'increases your Frost damage' port as written instead of being flattened to all_damage, which is what I was about to do after a literal grep came back empty. Eight talents conditional on a Frozen target are dropped or made unconditional, because nothing reads a target's debuffs. CoA's Runic Power is our life_force, so the resource grants are real.

nodes.name: Runic Reservoir
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Frost damage by 5% and your maximum Runic Power by 15.' The Frost damage ports and is doubled for the two ranks. frost_spell_damage IS LIVE: it is built with an f-string at abilities.py:1371 inside _school_damage_bonus and resolved against the school the ability actually deals, so a literal grep cannot see it - I nearly flattened this whole tree to all_damage on that basis, having already published the same wrong conclusion about arcane_spell_damage earlier the same day. Measured live at exactly 1.500 before trusting it. THE MAXIMUM-RESOURCE HALF IS DEAD: there is no key that raises a secondary pool's ceiling - max_energy_bonus and character max_energy are both authored somewhere in this project and read by nothing. A FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Piercing Icicles
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ice Barrage by 25% and of Lichfrost by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Ice Barrage by 20%.' PORTS EXACTLY (raised to 25%), extended to Lichfrost from CoA's Bone Legion so the node covers the spec's two main frost spells. Lichfrost generates 12 Life Force, so this pays for the rotation. Both FRACTIONS. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Bone Legion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lichfrost by a further 20% and your spell critical strike chance by 4%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Lichfrost by 10% and its Runic Power generated by 25%.' The damage ports (doubled). THE GENERATION HALF CANNOT: an ability's `generates` block is fixed data and no talent key scales it - grant_resource adds a SEPARATE grant on a proc, which is a different thing, and there is no ability_<id>_generates key. Freeze Dry two tiers up supplies the resource theme as a real on-crit grant instead. Replaced with crit, which this tree keys off four times. crit_chance_spell is PERCENTAGE POINTS; the ability key is a FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Hoarfrost Hands
nodes.description: Increases your hit chance by 8% and the duration of Ice Barrage by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the duration of Lichfrost's movement speed slow by 4 sec and your hit chance by 4%.' The hit chance ports (doubled). Movement speed is not a mechanic here, so that half is re-pointed to Ice Barrage's duration - it is a spell_dot, so +2 TURNS IS +2 FULL-VALUE TICKS (abilities.py:2777 derives per-turn from the ability's OWN base duration), taking it 2 -> 4 and doubling its total damage. hit_rating is PERCENTAGE POINTS. SMALL INTEGER IN TURNS, so spread() refuses to rank this node. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Freeze Dry
nodes.description: Your damaging spells restore 10 Life Force.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Glacial Impact now generates 20 Runic Power.' PORTS ALMOST VERBATIM - CoA'S RUNIC POWER IS OUR LIFE FORCE (Necromancer is (ResourceType.LIFE_FORCE, None), so it is the PRIMARY pool, with three generators). Only the Glacial-Impact scoping goes, since there is no per-ability proc trigger, and 20 drops to 10 in exchange because it now fires on every damaging cast. grant_resource routes through the same gain_resource() the three generators use, so the cap is respected, and its `amount` is FLAT - there is no pct_max field, which is the mistake that made Witch Doctor's Spiritual Devotee grant nothing at all.

nodes.name: Frigid Death
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by 50%.' PORTS VERBATIM. Glacial Impact is CoA's 'Requires Frozen Target' nuke, and our version carries no such gate - CoA gates this on the target being FROZEN. NOTHING READS A TARGET'S DEBUFFS anywhere in this engine, so the condition cannot be built - and a condition that silently never fires is worse than none. Dropped, with the value priced for being unconditional. Eight Rime talents carry this gate. So it is simply a hard-hitting 4-turn-cooldown frost spell here, and CoA's Glacier Lord ('guaranteed to critically strike against Frozen targets') is not built: there is no guaranteed-crit key either. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Arch Lich
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore 15 Life Force and 30 mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Frost spells now refund 3% of your maximum mana.' The crit trigger ports exactly. TWO DEPARTURES, both forced: grant_resource takes a FLAT `amount` and there is no percentage-of-maximum form, so '3% of maximum mana' becomes a flat number; and grant_resource takes a SINGLE {resource, amount} dict rather than a list, so one proc cannot grant both pools. Life Force wins because it is the primary resource and this spec's spenders read it. The description states the mana too and the tree delivers it through Raising the Kirin Tor's cost reduction instead - flagged here rather than quietly promising something the proc does not do. The Frost scoping goes: no per-school proc filter exists (proc['school'] only TYPES a damage_flat payload).

nodes.name: Frozen Power
nodes.description: Increases your Frost critical damage by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical damage with Frost spells by 50%.' PORTS VERBATIM via frost_crit_damage_pct, which the project already authors in two places - the per-school crit-damage family (fire_, frost_, shadow_) is read the same dynamic way as the per-school damage family. Folded in CoA's shared Frigidness passive ('increases your critical damage by 100% against Frozen targets'), which cannot be built: CoA gates this on the target being FROZEN. NOTHING READS A TARGET'S DEBUFFS anywhere in this engine, so the condition cannot be built - and a condition that silently never fires is worse than none. Dropped, with the value priced for being unconditional. Eight Rime talents carry this gate. A FRACTION, like every crit_damage_* key and unlike the crit_chance_* family, which are points.

nodes.name: Frozen Bodies
nodes.description: Killing an enemy or landing a critical strike increases the damage of your next spells by 4% for 4 turns, stacking up to 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor or critically strike with Frost damage you now gain a stack of Frozen Bodies: increases the damage of your next Glacial Impact by 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times. Reaching 10 stacks causes your next Glacial Impact to critically strike for 50% increased damage.' The stacking buff ports with CoA's 10 stacks and near its 3%. TWO CLAUSES FAIL: 'your next Glacial Impact' cannot be narrowed (a status effect carries only generic keys, not per-ability ones) and the at-10-stacks payoff needs a readable stack count, which does not exist. The kill half of the trigger is real - on_kill is live - but a proc takes ONE trigger, so on_crit is chosen as the far more frequent of the two and the description names both honestly rather than claiming only crits. 20 sec -> 4 turns. damage_dealt_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Soulfreeze
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 35% chance to chain frost through the target, dealing damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'All Frost damage you deal to Frozen targets now has a 25% chance to unleash Soulfreeze: launch a chain of frost at an enemy, dealing Frost Damage every 1 sec for 3 seconds. Each tick generates 3 to 8 Runic Power.' The dot ports at 3 turns (CoA's 3 one-second ticks map cleanly). CoA gates this on the target being FROZEN. NOTHING READS A TARGET'S DEBUFFS anywhere in this engine, so the condition cannot be built - and a condition that silently never fires is worse than none. Dropped, with the value priced for being unconditional. Eight Rime talents carry this gate. The per-tick resource generation cannot be built: there is no periodic trigger, because status_effects.py:914 ticks a dot by calling the recipient's own take_damage with no caster reference - Freeze Dry carries the resource theme instead. A proc-applied dot's `potency` is PER-TURN damage (34 a turn, 102 total), where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the total and gets divided.

nodes.name: Raising the Kirin Tor
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your spells by 20% and the cooldown of Ice Barrage by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Command spells now have a 40% chance to refund a portion of their Runic Power cost.' A chance-based REFUND cannot be built - nothing intercepts a resource SPEND, only grants, which is the same gap that killed Harvest Time's non-consume clause and Brigand's Rub It In - so the expected value is taken as a flat cost reduction instead, which is strictly more reliable and honest in the tooltip. 'Command spells' is not a category the engine knows, so it applies to everything. Folded in CoA's Refreshing Chill, whose cooldown-reset-plus-instant-cast cannot be built either (no cast times). all_ability_cost_pct and *_cooldown_pct are both FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION.

nodes.name: Master Lich
nodes.description: Your damaging spells have a 30% chance to leave the target taking 5% more Frost damage for 3 turns, stacking up to 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Soulfreeze now increases the enemy's Frost damage taken by you by 5% per tick for 8 sec, stacking 3 times.' The debuff ports with CoA's 5% and 3 stacks; 'per tick' and the Soulfreeze scoping do not (no periodic trigger, no per-ability proc trigger). THERE IS NO PER-SCHOOL DAMAGE-TAKEN KEY - the eight stat_mods a monster reads are armor, attack_power, damage_taken_pct, healing_taken_pct, magic/physical/spell_damage_taken_pct and magic_resistance - so Frost becomes magic, which covers it. PERCENTAGE POINTS inside a status effect, and positive INCREASES damage taken, so 5 is correct in both sign and magnitude.

nodes.name: Chilling Presence
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by a further 10% and reduces the cooldown of Chilling Presence by 35%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases the critical strike chance of Ice Barrage by 20% against Frozen targets.' THE PARTY HALF IS REAL BUT NOT FROM HERE: a talent effect can never reach an ally. The necromancer_chilling_presence ABILITY carries the party crit (crit_chance_spell and crit_chance_physical) and was converted from target_type 'self' to 'party' on 6 Nov 2026 - the same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras and that was applied to Reaper's two today. So this talent does what a talent can: make that aura available more often. The Frozen-gated crit clause is dropped - CoA gates this on the target being FROZEN. NOTHING READS A TARGET'S DEBUFFS anywhere in this engine, so the condition cannot be built - and a condition that silently never fires is worse than none. Dropped, with the value priced for being unconditional. Eight Rime talents carry this gate.

nodes.name: Command: Bonefreeze
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Animate: Frost Wyrm by 40% and reduces the cooldown of Command: Bonefreeze by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Command your Skeletal Mages to freeze enemies at target location for 40 seconds. Damage taken may end the effect.' Both abilities already exist in our data. A targeted ground freeze is positional and the break-on-damage clause has no mechanism (nothing controls whether an effect breaks when its carrier is hit), so the node modifies the two frost AoE abilities we have instead. Animate: Frost Wyrm is a frost spell_dot at target_type enemy_aoe, which is the closest thing this class has to CoA's mass freeze. Both FRACTIONS, the second a reduction.

nodes.name: Curse of the Lich
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by a further 5% and your Frost critical damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the range of your Rime spells by 6 yds and increases the Frost critical strike chance of you and your summons by 3%.' Range is meaningless here. THERE IS NO PER-SCHOOL CRIT CHANCE KEY - the per-school family covers damage (<school>_spell_damage) and crit DAMAGE (<school>_crit_damage_pct, verified read at abilities.py:1446 via f-string) but not crit chance - so the Frost scoping on the chance is dropped and the school flavour lands on the crit damage instead. The summons half fails too: no talent key and no proc reaches a pet's crit chance. crit_chance_spell is PERCENTAGE POINTS; frost_crit_damage_pct is a FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Harrowing Winds
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by a further 30% and your area damage by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Glacial Impact now deals an additional 50% of the damage dealt as Frost damage to enemies within 6 yds of the primary target.' A splash around the primary target is positional and nothing adds targets to an ability, so the splash becomes aoe_damage - which is live and applies to the spec's three enemy_aoe spells (Animate: Frost Wyrm, Command: Bonefreeze, Corpse Explosion). aoe_damage is read at abilities.py:1600 only when target_type is enemy_aoe, so it is genuinely scoped to area attacks rather than being a stealth global. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Champion of Kel'Thuzad
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Raise: Skeletal Mage by 40% and increases your pets' damage by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Skeletal Mages now only cost 1 Life Force.' CoA's Life Force is a POOL that summons occupy - 'occupying 2 Life Force' - which our engine does not model: a summon here costs its resource once and the pet then persists with no ongoing reservation. So 'only cost 1' becomes a flat cost reduction, which is the same intent through the mechanic we have. Necromancer genuinely summons four pets, so pet_damage is a legal key here (tools/qa_pet_keys.py exists because Witch Doctor Shadow Hunting shipped three pet keys on a class that summons nothing). Both FRACTIONS, the first a reduction. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Crown's Call
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 10% and your pets' health by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Intellect by 5% and the Frost damage dealt by your Undead minions by 10%.' The Intellect ports (doubled) and feeds the capstone's Intellect-to-spell-power conversion. THE MINIONS' FROST DAMAGE CANNOT BE SCOPED: pets scale off pet_damage, pet_health and pet_armor and nothing else - there is no per-school pet key, and pet_haste is read by nothing at all - so it becomes pet_health here, since Champion of Kel'Thuzad already supplies pet damage. intellect_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (character.py:1264 divides by 100); pet_health is a FRACTION. Two conventions in one dict, as usual.

nodes.name: Permafrost
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Glacial Impact and Animate: Frost Wyrm by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While your Lich Form is active, your Champion spells will now cooldown faster.' Both conditions fail: nothing reads whether another effect is active (which also killed Hard Bargain, Pathfinder and Chaos Fusion on other classes), and 'Champion spells' is not a category the engine knows. Built as a flat reduction on the spec's two frost cooldowns instead. Folded in CoA's Champion of Kel'thuzad level-50 passive, whose Permafrost proc treats the next two spells 'as if the target were Frozen' - a pseudo-state nothing tests for, so it has nothing to grant. FRACTIONS where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION; talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Ice Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 30% of your Intellect, your Frost damage by a further 15%, and your Frost critical damage by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA's shared Ice Mastery, level 20 passive: 'Increases your spell power by 30% of your Intellect.' PORTS EXACTLY as a conversion - spell_power is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and intellect in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, a legal pair, unlike the stamina and hit_rating targets that have cost eight nodes half their text across seven classes. Promoted to the capstone because a flat Intellect-to-spell-power conversion is the single largest thing a caster can be given, and paired with the tree's two Frost themes so the capstone reads as the payoff for everything below it: with Runic Reservoir and Chilling Presence that is +35% Frost damage, and with Frozen Power +75% Frost crit damage. ALL THREE ARE FRACTIONS.
